title: Pa. Guard flies search and rescue mission
description: Pennsylvania National Guard and Pennsylvania Helicopter Aquatic Rescue Team members take off in a UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter for a search and rescue mission from McEntire Joint National Guard base, Sept. 16, 2018. The crew searched parts of northern South Carolina for citizens stranded by flood waters or otherwise impacted by Hurricane Florence. Fortunately, no citizens required assistance.
